name: V-PLUGIN-SQL-LOAD
description: SQL Load table: Add, Add or replace by primary key and by Key columns, and Overwrite on PostgreSQL from SQL-produced table variables, a CSV Parser table and a Test Data CSV file; Commit each batch on with Stop on error on and off, and off as one transaction; a batch whose COMMIT the database refuses; a missing column and a missing key refused; Add or replace on MariaDB, Oracle, SQL Server and SQLite; on SQLite a clash rolls an Add and an Overwrite back whole, and a load waits for another writer on the same file; every table dropped in the Finally path.
